He placed the bottle on the windowsill, where it caught the sun, and climbed back up to keep the lamp burning for whoever was still counting.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘熄火的巨轮。高架桥上的路灯排成发亮的虚线，便利店的白光切开街角，出租车拖着红色尾灯滑过。清洁工推着水车，刷子留下潮湿的弧线；楼宇的窗子大多黑着，只有几扇像未眠的眼睛。风从地铁口升上来，带着铁轨和雨水的味道。此刻，城市终于慢下来，把喧嚣藏进清晨的薄雾里。","w03":"- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by asking a smaller version of the same problem for help.\n- It is like opening a set of nesting dolls until you find the tiny one that does not open.\n- Every recursive rule needs a stop rule, or it will keep asking forever."}
